dogecoin.text:
I was just in a twitter space with doge coin fans calling safemoon a shitcoin after the barstool sports guy promoted it.
This is basically my version of watching the bachelor.

@kevinrose lol the dogecoin community was inclusive and was never meant to be some scammy vc money grab, giving away and paying celebs to pump your coin. I used to just think you had a different take on things and I wanted to listen. Now im becoming convinced you are a scammy net negative.
